record.label: Frozen full688 q-head broad-network refit
record.summary: The frozen one-shot 22->64->64 refit passes every preregistered gate. OOF MSE is 3.066199675740282e-8 versus 3.117186304030849e-8 for the incumbent on the same rows (+1.63566%); all four fold means improve, network wins are 83.866%, paired z=25.716, and protected40 improves to 2.993270275e-8 from 3.061465198e-8. However, identical-population native model MSE is 2.973679246e-8, so this is not an absolute base win.
record.terminal_criterion: Solved only as a repair of the failed q-head by fixed model SHA d57407e0; it is not an absolute native-base or deployment win.
